description: Sealed record of the portfolio-construction weights Statistical Validation v1's combined-portfolio test is built on. Purpose: make the seal date auditable on its own, without requiring reconstruction from scattered git blame later -- same rationale as Equity Carry's Gate 1 leverage config (equity_carry_gate1_leverage_config.yaml).
what_this_tests: The REAL, currently-deployed portfolio construction -- the live sizing fractions that actually govern order sizes today -- not the theoretical ERC design anchor (meta_allocator_v0.py's ERC_WEIGHTS: Trend 60% / MeanReversion 30% / VRP 10%), which is explicitly documented in docs/SYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE.md as never applied to live sizing.

VRP_SLEEVE_FRACTION.note: vrp_capital = nav * 0.05, delta vs current SVXY holding, gate-first

Trend_leverage_caps.note: Trend has no fixed sleeve fraction -- vol-targeted (target_vol=0.15) with these leverage caps, not a hardcoded NAV fraction

seal_provenance.commit_message: Reduce MR/VRP sleeve fractions and Trend leverage ceiling; update locked-decision doc
seal_provenance.verification_method: git blame confirmed directly on each value's exact source line (not assumed from the commit diff alone) -- all four values (MR_SLEEVE_FRACTION x2, VRP_SLEEVE_FRACTION, max_leverage, bull_leverage) still attributed to this commit with zero later touches. order_engine.py's most recent commit (d041798, 2026-08-14) was checked explicitly and confirmed to be a pure log-write addition (32 insertions, 0 deletions) that referenced MR_SLEEVE_FRACTION without altering its value.

contamination_check.question: Could these weights have been set with knowledge of any combined-portfolio return analysis (blended_backtest.py output, Equity Carry Gate 2/diversification work, or similar)?
contamination_check.answer: No -- verified by direct date comparison, not assumed.
evidence: blended_backtest_results.txt earliest real commit (quant-portfolio): 2026-07-07 -- predates the seal by 18 days, but the seal commit's own rationale (stated in its message) is tied to individual-sleeve OOS Sharpe, not blended-portfolio metrics
erc_validation_summary.json / sleeve_returns.csv / report.md: 2026-07-13 to 2026-07-17 -- predates the seal
Equity Carry Gate 1 (leverage threshold), Gate 2 (HML/market regression), and the diversification analysis: all dated 2026-08-17/18 -- 3-4 weeks AFTER the seal date

erc_observation_mode_note.status: compute_erc_weights() in portfolio_risk.py is NOT used for live sizing
erc_observation_mode_note.evidence: Most recent portfolio_state.jsonl entries show erc_method='equal_fallback', erc_obs_count=0 -- insufficient live observation history for real inverse-vol ERC computation; currently defaults to equal-weight (33.33% each) when it runs at all
erc_observation_mode_note.implication: Statistical Validation v1's combined-portfolio test must use the live_sizing_fractions above, not any compute_erc_weights() output -- that computation has no live sizing authority and is not what actually governs today's orders
